ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Introduction to Technology in Library and Information Science] Be sure to enroll in your desired credit amount for this variable credit course (2 or 4 hours). The registration system will input 2 hours by default so if you want to enroll for 4 hours you will need to change it. See section description for 490TE at http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/courses/catalog
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science major(s).
